issue.title: Add support for Django 5.1 PostgreSQL connection pools to env.db_url

summary.text: The fix reproduced and guarded the reported issue with no regressions found, but Break My Fix found that extra_options is silently dropped for in-memory SQLite URLs: db_url and db_url_config with 'sqlite://:memory:' and extra_options={'timeout': 20} return only ENGINE and NAME, with no OPTIONS. Check the early-return path for ':memory:' SQLite URLs in db_url_config and make sure extra_options is…
